summary: Refresh: the DECLARATION safety/immunogenicity topline for VYD2311 (guided "October") is still unreleased and undated. The only November item is routine inducement grants (Nov 1); the October news was VMS063 measles data and the FLINTLOCK long-COVID start. The stock slid another -6.8%. catalysts.name: PEMGARDA EUA sunset
catalysts.description: PEMGARDA's emergency authorization ends unless a full approval lands first — the revenue cliff VYD2311 must beat.

risks: ⚠️ SURVIVAL: $160.1M cash at Jun 30, 2026 against $85M of H1 operating cash use (~11 months of runway, under 12), $55M still available on the ATM, and going-concern language flagged in Q2 coverage. A raise around the BLA is likely regardless of outcome.
The DECLARATION readout is overdue and un-dated. Silence past a guided window often precedes a delay, a reframed endpoint, or a financing.
Revenue cliff: PEMGARDA is the only revenue line and its EUA terminates Jun 29, 2027.
Accelerated Approval on immunogenicity with efficacy still blinded is a novel, contestable path — FDA could require efficacy first.
Sub-$1 share price: Nasdaq continued-listing notice / reverse split risk.

macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-product antibody company; outcome is regulatory and financing-driven. Rates matter through small-cap biotech risk appetite and the cost of the next raise.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.

catalystSpot.preRunup: No run-up: IVVD fell ~37% since the Sep 29 report and sold off even on a positive LIBERTY readout. The market is pricing financing and EUA-cliff risk, not the trial.

postWin.note: Kodiak Sciences (KOD) jumped ~166-180% on its Sep 28, 2026 Phase 3 DAYBREAK topline win in wet AMD — a small-cap biotech binary Phase 3 win just weeks before IVVD's own readout, direct evidence 150%+ single-day moves still happen in this regime. Capricor's own +300% Dec 2025 Phase 3 win is a further (cross-sector) tail-upside reference, though IVVD's Q2 earnings-miss overhang argues for a more moderate outcome than either.

postLose.note: EyePoint Pharmaceuticals (EYPT) fell 71% in one day on Aug 17, 2026 when its Phase 3 LUGANO trial missed its primary endpoint in wet AMD — a small-cap biotech binary Phase 3 miss just one month before IVVD's own DECLARATION readout, the direct downside precedent for this exact type of imminent single-catalyst risk.

Cross-sector but the same catalyst mechanism (binary Phase 3 topline in a beaten-down small-cap) — shows the tail-upside case for IVVD isn't fabricated, even if IVVD's own commercial overhang argues for a more moderate base case.
